pairs.evidence: packages/ui/src/components/audio/hunt.ts:54 A take's verdict and stage cross into the UI as bare strings and are rendered as raw tokens in a Chip (HuntMap.tsx:132 `label={take.verdict}`, with every non-'kept' value painted rose), so there is no closed union and no label table, and a new verdict shows its raw spelling.

techniques.evidence: packages/ui/src/components/audio/hunt.ts:54 The verdict is typed as a bare string, and HuntMap.tsx:132 renders the raw token as the label. TakeCard renders the stage token raw as well.
packages/ui/src/components/audio/hunt.ts:184 lengthOf renders zero and absent the same way ('–'), and lengthOf/HuntRenderBar glue the unit on at the call site (`${t}s`; a raw 'seconds' value).
packages/ui/src/components/audio/HuntShelf.tsx:84 The date is a slice of a raw ISO string (a UTC date): no fixed-moment primitive, no locale and no relative/absolute hover.
packages/ui/src/components/audio/HuntMap.tsx:82 A feature-local table, keyed by the leaf-state union, holds label and tone in one entry. Below the shared-palette scale threshold this is allowed.
packages/ui/src/components/audio/HuntMap.tsx:86 Amber is used only for leaves that wait on the operator's manual Suno step, and the tone is derived from the row's own state.
packages/ui/src/components/audio/HuntRenderBar.tsx:24 'Settled' is split into heard and rendering rather than claiming that every settled leaf was heard.
packages/ui/src/components/audio/Arrange.module.css:26 A card whose move is not yet confirmed is drawn with a dashed provisional rim on the value, not with a status hue.
packages/ui/src/components/audio/HuntMap.tsx:115 Model-drafted prompt and rationale text is rendered as escaped text nodes, and row names are capped at maxLength 80.
